_note: The herbalism bench's nine methods (docs/herbalism-revamp-plan.md §6). These are the owner-accepted starting values from 2026-10-02, tunable in play: change a number here and the bench, the card and the price all follow, because nothing in code repeats them. `potency` and `duration` multiply the line's strength at this step; a product row (herbal-products.json) multiplies again for the form it makes, so brew and steep are 1.0 here and the infusion/decoction and tincture/acetum split lives on the product. Mix is `mean`: the weighted mean of its parts, by dose. `minutes_per_dose` is world time per dose made, with no bulk discount (the owner's call: batch size costs time, not difficulty). `inputs_per_dose` is how many of the worked thing one dose takes: Dry and Reduce are the two concentration steps, two in and one out.

grind.name: Grind
grind.makes: powder; bark, sap or resin become salve base

mix.name: Mix
mix.takes: a ground herb (a poultice, water binds it), or salve bases with infused oil or an infusion
mix.makes: poultice, salve base, salve, balm or cream

brew.name: Brew
brew.takes: leaf or flower in water, or root, bark or berry in water
brew.makes: infusion (leaf, flower) or decoction (root, bark, berry and the other hard parts)

dry.name: Dry
dry.makes: one dried, stronger and longer lasting

extract.name: Extract
extract.takes: a part still in its shell, gland or pod

infuse.name: Infuse
infuse.takes: a dried herb and one oil for each dose
infuse.makes: infused oil, for salves, balms and creams

steep.name: Steep
steep.takes: a herb and one alcohol (tincture) or one vinegar (acetum) for each dose
steep.makes: a sealed jar that is ready in two weeks (tincture) or one week (acetum)

neutralize.name: Neutralize
neutralize.takes: a volatile thing and one neutralizer for each dose
neutralize.makes: the same thing, safe to handle: its harm is taken out

_brew_note: Brew turns leaf and flower into an infusion and the hard parts into a decoction (plan §6). Parts with no brew at all (oil, wax, mineral, liquid) are refused with the reason.
_concentration_note: Plan §5.3, owner ruling Q2 (cap nothing): each Dry or Reduce is concentration step n of its line, adds 2n to the DC (so n(n+1) in total over the line) and moves the result one rarity band rarer. Nothing else limits depth; the d20 does, because a bench check has no automatic natural 20.
